confidence_notes: Restaurant meals, cappuccino and draft beer use aggregated Riga cost-of-living prices. The cocktail estimate is less certain because current local submissions are sparse; wine is estimated slightly above draft beer. July accommodation prices are holistic seasonal estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Riga price data; accommodation is estimated for Riga in peak summer, with other Baltic capitals such as Vilnius and Tallinn as broad regional comparables.
